prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape literary editorial illustration for a surreal Russian monologue about uncertainty and technological risk. Scene: an empty dim lecture auditorium, a single old slender microphone at a lectern, a clear glass of water, in the background a blank grid calendar dissolving into darkness. No people necessary. Style: sophisticated grainy charcoal and muted copper oil pastel on warm ivory paper, restrained surrealism, cinematic negative space, tactile print texture. Wide horizontal 3:2 composition. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos.
